context_notes: We were filleting the group-bookings concept, not doing the structured discussion (user dismissed the gray-area multiselect twice to debate the idea). The crux we reached: v1 group bookings = a FREE RSVP coordination shell on an organizer-paid booking; the invite link is only decorative unless attendees pay their share (cost-splitting = GPAY-01/02, explicitly out of v1 scope). So v1's justification is 'foundation + growth funnel', and it hinges entirely on whether the paid version is coming later. That single product decision is the gate.
